Question
========
What is the effect of using `axis=0` when calling `numpy.mean(data, axis=0)`?

Answerlist
-----------
* It computes the mean across each row
* It computes the mean across each column
* It flattens the data completely and computes one overall mean
* It returns a 3D array of means
* It computes the mean for each individual element
* It sorts the means in descending order

Solution
========
`axis=0` computes the mean of each column (collapsing rows).
